---
name: Video prompt
about: Generate a stock video from a full scene-by-scene prompt (runs automatically on submit)
title: "Video: <company>"
labels: video-prompt
---
Company Name (NSE: SYMBOL) - <angle, e.g. Q2 profit growth vs valuation>

0-6 seconds - Hook
Open with this number before anything else: net profit grew <X>% year-on-year. Ask one curiosity question about it. Mention the company only after the number.

6-13 seconds - Did You Know
One surprising fact about the company that you have personally verified. Use only this fact, no extra numbers or claims.

13-26 seconds - Key Metrics
Facts: ROE: <X> %, Stock P/E: <X>, Price to Book Value: <X>, Market Cap: Rs <X> crore. Pick the 2 or 3 most striking and explain each in one plain-English clause.

26-38 seconds - Revenue & Profit Growth
Facts: Latest quarterly revenue: Rs <X> crore. Latest quarterly net profit: Rs <X> crore. Net profit grew <X>% year-on-year. Explain what this trend means.

38-48 seconds - Risk & Verdict
Raise one neutral question: does the current valuation already price in this growth? No buy/sell advice, and no new numbers.

48-55 seconds - Recap
"Follow for one data-backed stock breakdown every day, and check the numbers yourself before you decide."
